edits.text: 1. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to a request only to the extent the request seeks information protected from disclosure by attorney-client privilege, work-product protection, or another specifically applicable protection. For each request, Defendant states below whether responsive documents will be produced and identifies any objection and its particular basis. No general objection is asserted as a substitute for a request-specific objection.
edits.name: Request-specific objections

edits.text:
2. REQUEST-BY-REQUEST RESPONSES. Complete and serve a separate response for every request using the following format; do not serve this response with any bracketed field incomplete:

Request No. [NUMBER]: [INSERT REQUEST VERBATIM OR IDENTIFY IT SUFFICIENTLY].
Response: [STATE WHETHER RESPONSIVE DOCUMENTS WILL BE PRODUCED; IF SO, STATE THAT THEY WILL BE PRODUCED, SUBJECT TO ANY STATED LIMITATION].
Objection(s), if any: [IDENTIFY EACH OBJECTION AND ITS PARTICULAR BASIS, INCLUDING THE PORTION OF THE REQUEST AFFECTED AND THE REASON].
Production limitation or clarification, if any: [DESCRIBE].

Repeat for each request. Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents as stated in the completed responses.
edits.name: Request-by-request responses

edits.text: 3. PRIVILEGE LOG. For each document withheld in whole or in part on a claim of privilege or protection, provide a log entry identifying the document (including date, author, recipient(s), document type, and a non-privileged description sufficient to assess the claim) and specifying the privilege or protection asserted and the basis for that claim. Do not include privileged substance. Complete and attach the document-specific log before service; if no responsive documents are withheld on these grounds, state that expressly. No log is attached to this draft.
edits.name: Privilege log

edits.text: 4. RESERVATION. Defendant will supplement these responses as required by applicable rules. Any supplementation will identify the request affected and the additional response or production.
edits.name: Limited reservation
